name: Kiyose (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kiyose city emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kiyose, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1961.

features.role: Kiyose city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised character
